translatorNotes: Informal du used throughout, standard German.
No em-dashes used anywhere; the source's comma-spliced appositive style was rendered with commas and colons in German.

Meta platform/policy names kept literal: 'Meta', 'Business Partner', 'Meta-Business-Partner-Programm', 'Meta-Business-Partner-Messaging-Tools'. Brand/platform names kept as-is: Meta, Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, n8n, Make, Zapier. Acronyms kept: DM, CRM, API, KI.
Currency localized in prose: '$1,000 and $5,000' -> '1.000 und 5.000 US-Dollar'; 'low hundreds of dollars' -> 'im niedrigen dreistelligen Dollarbereich'.

Terminology: comment -> Kommentar, DM -> DM (Direktnachricht), keyword -> Keyword, flagged/banned -> markiert/gesperrt, lead -> Lead, 'social media manager' -> 'Social-Media-Manager', 'X min read' -> 'X Min. Lesezeit', 'August 13, 2026' -> '13. August 2026'.

Internal same-site links repointed to /de (nav, breadcrumbs, footer, in-body /de/blog and /de/services links, /de/contact). Left unchanged: /privacy, /terms, sitemap.xml, mailto:, tel:, and external URLs (unsplash images, LinkedIn author profile, googletagmanager).
Language switcher added to nav (EN + ES links, DE current). Reciprocal EN/ES switcher and four hreflang alternates (en, es, de, x-default) apply across the locale set.

Article and FAQPage JSON-LD carry inLanguage 'de'; Article mainEntityOfPage @id and breadcrumb item URLs repointed to /de. author/publisher/image/dates/about labels left unchanged (about names kept in English as entity identifiers).
Asset paths changed from ../assets, ../css, ../js, ../favicon.ico to absolute /assets, /css, /js, /favicon.ico. gtag and og:image kept absolute.
